extDescription.message: Sync scrolling, clicks and hover between the two tabs of a Chrome Split View. Made for comparing live and staging sites.

cmdSyncCurrent.message: Start sync for the current Split View

cmdSyncAll.message: Start sync for all Split Views in this window

cmdStopCurrent.message: Stop sync for the current Split View

statusPausedBody.message: Split View found. Start sync to link both panes.

statusReloadingBody.message: A pane is reloading. Sync picks up again when it's done.

statusErrorBody.message: Reload the other pane, then start sync again.

statusNoSplitBody.message: Put two web pages side by side to compare them.

emptyStep1.message: Right-click a tab and choose “Add tab to new split view”.

emptyStep2.message: Pick the second page. Both must be regular websites (http or https).

emptyStep3.message: Open this menu again and press Start sync.

statusUnsupportedBody.message: Chrome pages, the Web Store and local files are closed to extensions. Open a regular website in a Split View.

sectionThisSplitHelp.message: Changes apply to both panes right away.

optNavigationHelp.message: Opens the same path on the other side, only between the two synced sites.

optClicksHelp.message: Repeats clicks on the matching element. Never on forms, payment or delete actions.

optHoverHelp.message: Shows hover styles and hover menus on both sides.

optCursorHelp.message: Shows a pointer in the other pane where your mouse is. Only shows, never clicks.

optWpAdminBarHelp.message: Hides the toolbar while syncing so both layouts line up.

sectionDefaultsHelp.message: Used when a new pair is found. Existing pairs keep their own settings.

optAlwaysShowHelp.message: Turn off to show the floating button only when you choose to.

offsetHelp.message: The right pane scrolls this many pixels further than the left.

hardReloadLeftLabel.message: Hard reload left pane, bypassing the cache

hardReloadRightLabel.message: Hard reload right pane, bypassing the cache

rulerLabel.message: Ruler line. Drag to move, press Delete to remove.

toastNoPair.message: No Split View pair found. Try again in a moment.

statusOriginPausedTitle.message: Paused: a different site was opened

statusOriginPausedBody.message: One pane left the site you started sync for. Press Start sync to sync these two sites.

needPairHint.message: Open two web pages in a Split View to use this.

altHint.message: Tip: hold Alt (Option) while scrolling to move one side on its own; the difference becomes the offset.

optAlignHelp.message: Pixel-exact copies the scroll position. On element/content keeps the same section at the top when the pages differ in height.
